messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Orbital Health — Order Form + DPA redlines and SCCs questions

Team — attaching the initial redlines we received from Orbital Legal (see attachments). Highlights from procurement: they flagged two items that will block signature if we don't resolve by next week: 1) a delegation ask that would make Orbital the controller for a subset of telemetry; and 2) a pricing-trigger clause tied to onshore-only processing that they want added to the Order Form.

Quick asks:
- Ben / Karthik: can you confirm whether we can accept the limited controller delegation for non-PHI telemetry (see p.3 of the DPA redline) and what operational controls (SLA, access logs, subprocessors list) we need to add?
- Lauren: procurement needs a recommendation on the pricing-trigger language — can we propose a compromise (one-time uplift vs. monthly surcharge) tied to documented onshore infra requests?
- Legal (cc): please flag any absolute blockers in the attached Orbital_DPA_Redlines_20260903.docx; if we need a conference with their counsel, I can schedule.

Timing: Orbital is asking for answers by EOD Tue 9/8 to meet their month-end approvers. I think we can triage: legal redline pass + commercial compromise.

Attachments: Orbital_DPA_Redlines_20260903.docx; OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf

Thanks —
Markus
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@orbitalhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@orbitalhealth.com, legal@orbitalhealth.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orbital Health — Order Form + DPA redlines and SCCs questions

Markus — thanks for the quick turn. Attaching our redline bundle (we also uploaded to the shared drive). Short summary for your team:

1) Delegation / Roles: our security/privacy team requires that Orbital be designated as controller for telemetry used in our analytics dashboards (not for patient records). This is fundamental for our downstream processing agreements. If Redwood is unwilling to accept the controller designation for that telemetry, we need explicit language guaranteeing no automated profiling and a right to audit. (See comment 7 on p.3.)

2) Pricing trigger: we asked for a clear contractual mechanism if data residency/onshore-only hosting is required after go-live — Orbital cannot assume variable CAPEX; a defined surcharge tied to verified onshore instances is standard for us. We proposed a one-time migration fee + monthly delta; open to Redwood counterproposals.

3) SCCs / Transfers: need confirmation that subcontractors outside the EEA/UK will be covered by SCCs or equivalent safeguards — our legal says list + flow-down obligations is required.

We can carve out a 30-minute call next Tue (9/8) morning to walk through redlines and attempt a path to sign-off. Proposed attendees: Markus, Ben (commercial), your legal lead, and our GC.

Best,
Sarah Lopez
Senior Counsel, Orbital Health

Attachment stubs: Orbital_DPA_Redlines_20260903.docx (redline), OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf (annotated)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lopez <sarah.lopez@orbitalhealth.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, legal@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 4 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Orbital Health — Order Form + DPA redlines and SCCs questions

Sarah — thanks for the clear summary and the redlines. Quick responses to the three bullets (so internal folks have context before the call):

1) Delegation / Roles: we are open to a narrowly-scoped controller designation limited to non-PHI telemetry used for Orbital's analytics dashboards, provided we get the following:
   - explicit list of telemetry types (MD5 hashes, usage counters, anonymized latency metrics) in an annex;
   - a mutual audit rhythm (annual, scoped to telemetry only); and
   - a carve for emergency support access with logging and 48-hour notice where operationally possible.

If Legal confirms there are no downstream compliance blockers, we can accept this in principle and propose draft language for the annex.

2) Pricing trigger: commercial compromise proposal: a one-time migration fee calculated as a fixed percentage of the first 3 months' committed spend + a monthly delta equal to the measured incremental infra cost (with a cap of X% of MRR). If that sounds workable we will build the exact formula into the Order Form appendix. Lauren — can you draft a short clause with language like that? We should also include a short example calculation.

3) SCCs / Transfers: Karthik, please confirm that our subprocessor list + SCC execution playbook covers Orbital's ask; if any processors are not covered we need to surface remediation steps.

Next steps:
- Karthik / Legal: confirm SCCs coverage and whether the controller delegation triggers any change to our liability/indemnity positions.
- Lauren: draft pricing-trigger appendix (example calc).
- Markus: set up 30-min sync with Sarah and their GC for Tue 9/8 09:30 PT (proposed).

If we can close the open items on Tuesday I think we can hit Orbital's internal approver window.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Manager, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
